messages:
dara: Seeing an odd parity issue in python SDK rerank.batch when using async + batching. Sample app expects nested lists of floats, but sometimes we get nested lists of dicts with extra keys. Breaking downstream code.

dara: Minimal repro from async sample app:
```python
resp = await client.embeddings.rerank.batch(queries=["q"], docs=[["a","b"]])
# sometimes -> [[0.95, 0.04]]
# sometimes -> [[{"score":0.95, "meta":{...}}, {"score":0.04, "meta":{...}}]]
```

henry: Which SDK version? Is this only when auth refresh retries fire? Last time a retry branch skipped the normalizer.

dara: 0.9.2-dev wheel. I noticed it correlates with a token refresh (401 -> refresh -> replay). The sync client always returns floats. Async batch flips shape.

leila: Likely cause: batching wrapper has two codepaths (simple vs enriched response). The enriched path returns dicts and the wrapper doesn't canonicalize on the retry path. We should canonicalize at the public method boundary.

leila: Quick mitigation: add a tiny helper in examples/rerank_helpers.py so sample apps can normalize both shapes without waiting for SDK release: 
```python
def normalize_rerank_output(rows):
    # rows: List[List[float]] OR List[List[dict]]
    normalized = []
    for row in rows:
        normalized.append([item.get("score") if isinstance(item, dict) else item for item in row])
    return normalized
```

henry: Agree. Long-term: SDK should add include_metadata: bool = False param to rerank.batch. Default False returns List[List[float]] for backward compat. If True returns List[List[dict]] with metadata. Update typing stubs accordingly.

dara: Can someone open a PR? Unit tests should cover sync+async+retry. Also add a mypy test for the stub change.

sdk-bot: Issue created: #3699 - "python: rerank.batch async returns metadata dicts on retry; typing mismatch". Linked PR template.

leila: I'll take the PR. Plan: (1) add canonicalizer at public entrypoint (sync+async), (2) widen typing to include Mapping temporarily, (3) add include_metadata flag and typed branch, (4) update examples to include normalize helper and mention payload size when metadata enabled, (5) backport to 0.9.x.

henry: Please add a one-line CHANGELOG entry under "Bugfix (python)" so support can reference it.

dara: Thanks all. Will re-run sample-app once PR merges.
